findings.issue: 四つ is read よっつ (yottsu), never よんつ. The kana transcription gives the counter as よんつ, teaching a wrong reading of the native counter series (ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ, よっつ...).
findings.current: てーぶるのうえにこっぷがよんつあります
findings.suggested: てーぶるのうえにこっぷがよっつあります

findings.issue: Same reading error as kana: 四つ romanized as 'yontsu' instead of 'yottsu'. This is a wrong reading, not the known punctuation/katakana issue.
Token 四 inside 四つ has reading よん; in this compound it is よっ (四つ = よっつ, with gemination). The attached note on the つ token also romanizes it 'yotsu' instead of 'yottsu'.

Wrong particle function: says に marks 紙 as 'the place where the action happens' — that is で's function. With 引く/書く, に marks the surface/target where the result ends up (place of result), a distinction textbooks explicitly teach (紙に書く vs 図書館で勉強する).
findings.current: The particle に marks 紙 ('paper') as the place where the action happens.
findings.suggested: The particle に marks 紙 ('paper') as the surface where the line ends up (target/place of result) — unlike で, which marks where an action occurs.

findings.issue: Same wrong particle-function claim in Portuguese: に described as 'o lugar onde a ação acontece', which is the function of で. Here に marks the surface/target where the result (the line) remains.
findings.current: A partícula に marca 紙 ('papel') como o lugar onde a ação acontece.
findings.suggested: A partícula に marca 紙 ('papel') como a superfície onde a linha fica (alvo/local do resultado) — diferente de で, que marca onde a ação ocorre.

findings.issue: Role of 紙 repeats the same error: labels it place where the action occurs (で-function) instead of the target/surface of the result marked by に.

Structurally inaccurate mirror: 会場の is a genitive modifier of 入り口 (one NP, 'the venue's entrance'), not a topic — there is no は. The literal invents 'As for the venue' and then also duplicates it as '(of the hall)'.
findings.current: As for the venue, at the entrance (of the hall), I am waiting.
findings.suggested: At the entrance of the venue, (I) am waiting.

findings.issue: Same misparse in Portuguese: 'Quanto ao local' presents the genitive 会場の as if it were a は-topic. The NP is simply 'a entrada do local do evento'.
findings.current: Quanto ao local, na entrada (do salão), estou esperando.
findings.suggested: Na entrada do local do evento, estou esperando.

findings.issue: Token array out of sentence order: sub-tokens ご and 存知 sit at positions 0-1, before 先生. Elsewhere (e.g. sent:gen-65129f9e516a) component sub-tokens appear immediately before their compound; here they should come right before ご存知 (after を). Sequential rendering breaks.
findings.current: tokens start: ご, 存知, 先生, は, その, 話, を, ご存知, です
findings.suggested: Move sub-tokens ご and 存知 to directly before the compound ご存知 (after を)

findings.issue: Ungrammatical Portuguese gloss 'o cima da mesa' ('cima' does not take a masculine article this way). Should be 'a parte de cima da mesa' or 'em cima da mesa'.
findings.current: テーブルの上 (o cima da mesa) é o local
findings.suggested: テーブルの上 (a parte de cima da mesa) é o local
